name: uncver-ollama-qwen3-0.6b-ai
description: AI router on Redis stream — connects to uncver-ollama for LLM inference via qwen3:0.6b
author: uncver

run.command: podman run -d --name uncver-ollama-qwen3-0.6b-ai --network uncver-network -e REDIS_HOST=uncver-redis-stream -e REDIS_PORT=6379 -e SHARED_STREAM=uncver:ai:router -e OLLAMA_MODEL=qwen3:0.6b -e OLLAMA_HOST=uncver-ollama -e OLLAMA_PORT=11434 docker.io/uncoverthefuture/uncver-ollama-qwen3-0.6b-ai:latest
